title: Pure Aroma
summary: Aroma cards with generic Plant Extra Deck monsters and staples. Aroma monsters apply continuous effects while your LP are higher than your opponent's, and trigger mandatory or optional effects whenever your LP increase.

summary.title: Starters
points: Aromalilith Rosalina (Level 1 DARK Plant Tuner) Special Summons a non-Tuner Aroma monster directly from the Deck on Normal or Special Summon (locking you into Plant summons for the turn), or discards itself as a Quick Effect to gain half of an Aroma monster's ATK in LP.

Aroma Blend discards a card to place Humid Winds, Dried Winds or Blessed Winds face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone from the hand or Deck, and banishes itself from the GY to Fusion Summon an Plant Fusion Monster (banishing Extra-material Plants if your LP are higher).
Humid Winds pays 1000 LP to search any Aroma monster and gains 500 LP if your LP are lower than the opponent's.

summary.title: Opening: Aromalilith Rosalina + Any Card
steps: Normal Summon Aromalilith Rosalina to Special Summon Aromage Laurel from the Deck.
Link Summon Aromaseraphy Jasmine using Rosalina and Laurel; Laurel's GY effect triggers to gain 500 LP, which immediately triggers Jasmine to search Aromage Jasmine or Aromaseraphy Angelica.
Use Aromaseraphy Jasmine to tribute a Plant she points to and Special Summon another Plant from the Deck, then climb into Aromalilith Rosemary (Link-3) to search Aroma Blend.
Activate Aroma Blend to place Blessed Winds or Dried Winds in your Spell & Trap Zone, then banish Aroma Blend from the GY to Fusion Summon Aromalilith Magnolia.

summary.title: LP Gain Triggers & Winds Traps
summary.text: Aroma Garden, Aroma Gardening, Blessed Winds, Aroma Healing and Aromaseraphy Angelica let you gain LP on both players' turns. On LP gain: Aromage Jasmine draws a card, Aromasersaphy Jasmine searches a Plant, Aromaseraphy Sweet Marjoram destroys a card on the field, Aromaseraphy Rosemary negates a face-up card, Aromage Cananga bounces a Spell/Trap, Aromage Marjoram banishes from the opponent's GY, and Dried Winds destroys an opposing face-up monster.

summary.title: Extra Deck Bosses & Locks
points: Aromalilith Rosemary (Link-3) searches an Aroma card on summon, and when you gain LP, Special Summons up to 3 Aroma monsters from your hand to zones it points to.

Aromalilith Magnolia (Level 8 Fusion) protects all your Plants from destruction by card effects while your LP are higher, pays 2000 LP to banish cards on the field equal to your Humid, Dried and Blessed Winds, and boosts all your Plants by the LP you gain.
Aromaseraphy Sweet Marjoram (Level 6 Synchro) searches Humid, Dried or Blessed Winds on Synchro Summon, protects your Plants from targeting while your LP are higher, and pops a card on LP gain.
Aromalilith Rosalina locks you into Special Summoning Plant monsters for the turn, so the Extra Deck is stacked with Plant Synchros, Links and Sacred Tree Beast, Hyperyton.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's Sunavalon / Rikka hybrid engine is omitted so this build stays pure Aroma and Plant LP control.
